<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 510" width="640" height="510">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="510" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- axes -->
  <line x1="60" y1="440" x2="60" y2="22" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="55,30 60,14 65,30" fill="#000"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="440" x2="580" y2="440" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polygon points="570,435 586,440 570,445" fill="#000"/>
  <text x="70" y="28" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">energy</text>
  <text x="330" y="462" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">progress of reaction</text>

  <!-- reference levels -->
  <line x1="60" y1="260" x2="468" y2="260" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,3"/>
  <line x1="420" y1="380" x2="468" y2="380" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,3"/>
  <line x1="90" y1="80" x2="240" y2="80" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="2,3"/>
  <text x="100" y="282" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">reactants</text>
  <text x="480" y="386" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">products</text>

  <!-- curve without catalyst (solid) -->
  <path d="M60 260 L120 260 C180 260 204 80 240 80 C294 80 318 380 420 380 L440 380" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- curve with catalyst (dashed, lower peak) -->
  <path d="M60 260 L120 260 C180 260 204 164 240 164 C294 164 318 380 420 380 L440 380" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="8,5"/>

  <!-- activation energy arrow -->
  <line x1="90" y1="260" x2="90" y2="80" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <polygon points="85,88 90,74 95,88" fill="#000"/>
  <polygon points="85,252 90,266 95,252" fill="#000"/>
  <text x="98" y="180" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="16" font-style="italic" fill="#000">E<tspan font-size="11" dy="4">a</tspan></text>

  <!-- enthalpy change arrow -->
  <line x1="468" y1="260" x2="468" y2="372" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <polygon points="462,366 468,382 474,366" fill="#000"/>
  <text x="478" y="325" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="16" font-style="italic" fill="#000">ΔH</text>

  <!-- leader lines and labels -->
  <line x1="312" y1="230" x2="350" y2="190" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="352" y="186" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">without catalyst</text>
  <line x1="210" y1="184" x2="210" y2="300" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="210" y="322" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#000">with catalyst</text>

  <!-- caption -->
  <text x="300" y="500" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#000">Fig. 4.1</text>
</svg>
